title: 岩包踏步接掌扶
description: 剪纸将低岩包踏步与轻掌扶动作组合，完整人形和落地空间清楚。

art_direction.medium: colored pencil sports sketch with layered visible pencil marks
art_direction.scene: An original layered-paper illustration depicts a fictional adult stepping onto a broad low volume while lightly pressing a palm against another generous surface for balance. The other shoe stays on a positive wall foothold, and the second hand holds a large coral jug. The wall is gently slabby, allowing an upright torso and a controlled compact weight transfer. Show the entire opaque-clothed adult in a wide oblique view with continuous thick crash mats and an empty landing zone. Use visible paper fibers, sage wall layers, warm ochre volumes, and soft stacked shadows. Keep anatomy and contacts believable. No jumping, captions, brands, high ledges, or extreme pose.
